name: White corner building at the mouth of David Street

notes.method: Edge 1 (west, on the square) measured on C03 (2016, frontal; 88 px/m from the 5.3 m OSM edge, which makes the ceramic plaque 1.0 m wide as in the notes): windows at u 0.95 / 2.31 / 3.73 (0.6 / 0.8 / 0.6 m wide, 1.15-1.25 m tall, sills ~5.4 m), oculus 0.6 m at u 4.74, eave ~7.4 m. Ground floor from 142 (2019): shop under a flat canopy, the west door with a white scroll grille under a small quarter-round dark-grey awning at the south end, downpipe at the SW corner. 142 (vertical scale from the oculus, ~53 px/m) agrees: canopy ~4.0-4.2 m, quarter-round awning ~4.6-5.2 m over the south door.
notes.compromises: The oculus cannot be expressed (no circular opening) and is left out; one window width (0.7 m) for all three. The hipped standing-seam roof needs the HIPPED list in make_spec.py (code), so the roof stays flat; height 8.3 puts the generated cornice at 7.05-7.37 m, on the real eave line (7.4 m), and lets the upper floor fit with sills at 5.5 m. The south door is ~0.8 x 3.9 m with a white scroll grille in reality; 'door' openings are fixed at 2.75 m and shops must be >= 1.4 m wide, so it is a 0.9 m door of standard height. The quarter-round awning is a sloped generic awning. Edge 0 (David St) keeps the automatic souq profile.
notes.material: Clean near-white ashlar with visible coursed joints (C03), not plaster; tint is at the clamp limit (build_city divides by 1.06 and clamps at 1.0), so it cannot render whiter than the ashlar texture. The SCSC tint is kept warmer for contrast.
notes.edges: Edge keys follow the scene_spec ring as of 2026-10-19 evening (ring start rotated by the city-wide make_spec changes): 0 = west facade on the square (u from the north end, David St corner). Before the rotation this was 1.
